cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Keep Hope Operational
cards.instruction: Protect their hope with practical evidence and next steps while quietly withholding what makes the impossible outcome unlikely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. The model cloud produced one drop. Let's build the welcome tray.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That doesn't prove the full rain machine works.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. It proves the tray has a purpose.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then put the small success where we can still see it.
